summary: Frontend tests (mobile 375x667) for the Claude chat summary and Google Drive shared-folder features. All requested flows PASS. 1) /drive shows the drive-not-setup empty state when no folder is set (admin and employee). 2) Admin: Library > Integrations > drive-shared-folder box. Pasting the folder link and tapping Save shows the toast 'Company folder set to “01032024”', and drive-shared-folder-name shows the folder. 3) Library > library-row-drive opens /drive with 18 PDF files (size and date shown) and the breadcrumb '01032024'. Searching 'Armi' returns 1 result, a search with no matches shows drive-empty, and search clear restores all 18. Tapping a file opens a new tab; the file endpoint returns 200 application/pdf inline, and 401 without a token. 4) Employee can open Company Drive and sees 18 files. Employee cannot reach integrations (integrations-admin-only). 5) Chat summary on #Allied Health (admin) and #Celebrate the Wins (employee): the loading state shows, then chat-summary-text has an accurate Claude summary. Closing works via both chat-summary-close and the backdrop. #announcements (0 messages) shows chat-summary-error 'There aren't enough messages to summarise yet' with a working retry. 6) Regression: Ask AI streams an answer; chat send works in the admin-employee DM. An invalid folder link returns 400 'Paste a Google Drive folder link'. CLEANUP DONE: the shared folder was cleared from the UI with drive-shared-folder-clear, and GET /api/drive/shared now returns 409 for both roles. Google Drive is still connected and Google Chat links were not changed. No deprecated Expo packages were found (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner and expo-background-fetch are not used).

minor.issue: Message lines are built from raw UTC created_at[:16] (server.py:1259), so Claude's summary quotes UTC times (e.g. '03:19') that don't match the local times in the chat bubbles. Australian staff will see times about 10-11h off. Either convert to the company timezone or tell the model not to mention clock times.

The long-lived session bearer token is sent in the URL query string (src/api.ts:67). It can leak into browser history, proxy/server access logs, and copied or forwarded links. Use a short-lived, single-file signed token instead.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Change folder' button runs DELETE right away with no confirmation. All staff lose Company Drive until a new folder is saved. Errors are also swallowed (.catch(() => {})) with no toast. Reference: app/integrations.tsx:46-50,164

issues: Modal uses animationType='slide', so the dim backdrop slides up with the sheet instead of fading in. Use a fade backdrop with a slide-up sheet.
The 'Try again' button is shown for the 400 'not enough messages' error, where retrying always fails the same way. Show it only for 5xx/network errors.

action_items: LOW: Add a confirm step to 'Change folder' (or keep the current folder until a new one is saved), and show a toast if DELETE fails (integrations.tsx clearFolder).
LOW: Replace ?token=<session> in openDriveFile with a short-lived signed file token.
LOW: Convert message timestamps to the company local timezone before sending them to Claude for summaries (server.py:1259).
LOW: Hide chat-summary-retry for the 400 'not enough messages' response.
critical_code_review_comments: drive.tsx: subfolder navigation and breadcrumb tapping (drive-crumb-N) were not exercised because the test folder 01032024 only contains PDFs. The logic looks correct (path slice).
chat-summary.tsx: the summary is re-requested every time the sheet opens (no caching). That's acceptable, but each open is a paid Claude call.
